description: grype CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record) - the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that grype is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (compliance_core, computing_core) plus grype itself, with the dependencies at released tags and grype at a commit; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: this plugin ships no GRIFT yet. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network, so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). The Grype binary and its database are not part of this record: they are placed by an operator step (req-grype-binary), and the live corpus tier is the nightly's concern (req-grype-corpus).
